newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland Bank sees inflation below two pct in 96-97.
newsitem.headline: Finland Bank sees inflation below two pct in 96-97.

text.p: The Bank of Finland said on Wednesday it forecast Finnish inflation to remain below two percent this year and in 1997.

"For next year, both the rise in consumer prices and underlying inflation are estimated to remain somewhat below two percent," the bank said in a statement in connection with the release of its latest economic review.
"The rise in consumer prices is likely to remain close to 1.5 percent for the current year," it said. @
"Subdued price developments and a contraction of the central government deficit provide a good foundation for continued exchange rate stability in the years to come," it said.
On the other hand, recent developments did not signal deflation either, it said.
"There are no signs of a decline in the overall level of prices. In other words, recent developments are not signalling deflation," the central bank said.
